title: ModelRegistry canonical model record, version 1.0
description: One model, normalized for machines. Every field is either confirmed against a primary source or explicitly null: the registry never fills a gap with an estimate. `legacy` carries the registry's own editorial fields unchanged so no published fact is lost in the projection.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record shape. A breaking change bumps it and the manifest.

slug.description: Stable canonical identifier and the /models/{slug} path segment.

aliases.description: Former slugs that redirect here. Never a second canonical id.

family.description: Model family (for example a shared base or generation name). Null when the laboratory does not state one.

accessType.description: open-weight means the laboratory publishes weights the public can download. A hosted-only model is proprietary even when its licence is permissive.

canonicalApiIds.description: Exact model strings a provider API accepts, copied from the provider, not inferred from the display name.

routerIds.description: Third-party routing identifiers (OpenRouter, Bedrock, Vertex). A router id is not a provider id.

huggingfaceRepo.description: Canonical Hugging Face repository for open-weight models. Null for closed models and for weights not published there.

license.description: Licence as the laboratory states it, verbatim. A description, not an SPDX identifier.

licenseSpdx.description: SPDX identifier when the licence is unambiguously one. Null when the laboratory ships a custom or unnamed licence.

parameterCountTotal.description: Total parameters, parsed only from an unambiguous statement in parameterSourceText. Null when the laboratory does not publish a number.

parameterCountActive.description: Active parameters per token for mixture-of-experts models, when stated. Null otherwise.

parameterSourceText.description: The laboratory's own wording, so a parsed number can always be checked against it.

quantizedVariants.description: Verified GGUF or MLX distributions. Empty means none verified, never none exists.

hfDownloads30d.description: Hugging Face downloads over the last 30 days, from the Hub API, with the retrieval date in lastVerifiedAt semantics. Null when not measured.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output in tokens, only when the source states a plain token limit. Null for image, audio and video limits and for conditional limits such as 'up to X with long decode'.

knowledgeCutoff.description: Training data cutoff, only when the laboratory states a date. Null otherwise.

modalities.description: Modalities as the registry records them, undirected.

modalitiesInput.description: Input modalities, only when the source states the direction. Null when the source publishes one undirected list.

modalitiesOutput.description: Output modalities, only when the source states the direction.

priceHistory.description: Append-only observations, oldest first. An earlier entry is never edited; a new price adds a line.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'active' includes models replaced in their role: superseded is not retired, because no laboratory withdrew them.

deprecationDate.description: Date the provider announced the model will be withdrawn. Null when none announced.

sunsetDate.description: Last date the model can be called. Null when none announced.

recommendedReplacementSlug.description: Slug of the model that took over this one's role, when one is recorded.

trainingComputeFlops.description: Training compute in floating-point operations, only from a cited estimate. Null otherwise.

trainingHardware.description: Training hardware as stated or estimated. Null otherwise.

attributions.description: Upstream open datasets this record was enriched from, with the licence they require crediting.

telemetry.description: Measured latency, throughput and uptime. Empty when nothing has been measured; never filled with a placeholder.

lastVerifiedAt.description: Date the record's fields were last read against the cited primary sources.

publicStatus.description: The only verification states the registry publishes. Null when the record carries no public state at all; a half-confirmed label is never exposed.

legacy.description: The registry's editorial fields, unchanged: the long highlight, laboratory-reported benchmarks, sub-variants, links, per-field citations and change log. Present so the canonical projection loses nothing.

capabilities.description: null means not confirmed for this model, which is different from false (confirmed absent).
